writeup: Woot's Sellout has the Razer Kiyo V2 4K streaming webcam in Quartz (model RZ19-05370300-R3U1) open box for $48.49. It uses an 8.3MP Sony STARVIS sensor with AI auto-framing and connects over USB-C.
